name: Ezuri's Predation
oracle_text: For each creature your opponents control, create a 4/4 green Phyrexian Beast creature token. Each of those tokens fights a different one of those creatures.
blocked_sentences: For each creature your opponents control, create a 4/4 green Phyrexian Beast creature token.

needs.what: a 4/4 green Phyrexian Beast creature token (subtypes Phyrexian and Beast), e.g. id phyrexian_beast_4_4_g
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has beast_4_4_g, a 4/4 green Beast with no Phyrexian subtype; the pool does distinguish Phyrexian (germ_0_0_b is a Phyrexian Germ), so substituting it would make tokens that miss Phyrexian-matters cards. Once the token exists, the rest looks expressible as a for_each over {zone: battlefield, controller: opponent, types: [Creature]} whose body is create_token with `as` followed by fight pairing that bound token with the loop object, which gives each token a different creature.
